// diagnostic

E0734

Tag `{tag}` has an incomplete policy.

What

Tag `{tag}` has an incomplete policy.

Why

A value tag's denials are its own `#FX(!…)` row; its `impl Marker` block holds `sites: [.TypeUse]` and, optionally, `from`, `timing` and `protects`.

Fix

Write `#FX(!Net) {tag}: struct { impl Marker { sites: [.TypeUse] } }` with the destinations it may not reach; add `from: [source.path]` when it is needed.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0734: Tests/UI/Taint/tag_marker_timing_and_protects_cases.stderr.

Error [jet.InvalidTagPolicy]: `timing` on the tag `Key` is not `.Free` or `.Fixed`
  --> Tests/UI/Taint/tag_marker_timing_and_protects_cases.jet:5:17
    |
  5 |         timing: .Constant
    |                 ^^^^^^^^^
 Why: A tag's `timing` is a case of core.compiler.lang's TagTiming
 Fix: Write `timing: .Free` or `timing: .Fixed`

Error [jet.AmbiguousTraitConstant]: The impl gives the constant `timing` twice

    |
 14 |         timing: .Free
    |         ^^^^^^
 Why: An implementation has one value for each trait constant
 Fix: Remove one `timing: …`

Error [jet.InvalidTagPolicy]: `protects` on the tag `Trust` is not `.Secrecy` or `.Integrity`
  --> Tests/UI/Taint/tag_marker_timing_and_protects_cases.jet:22:19
    |
 22 |         protects: .Authenticity
    |                   ^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: A tag's `protects` is a case of core.compiler.lang's TagProtects
 Fix: Write `protects: .Secrecy` or `protects: .Integrity`
